Metadata.Goal: 按 D2=B 和 D4 让 .NET OM schema evolution 具备严格、原子、可诊断且兼容的 V2 能力。
Metadata.Description: 补齐 migration/rollback preflight、transactionality、legacy detect-only upgrade 与结构化 broad diff。

cdt:Risks.cdt:Risk: 非原子迁移可能破坏既有 schema state。
legacy 自动升级可能意外改变用户数据。

TaskSpace.name: harden-dotnet-om-schema-evolution-parity
TaskSpace.Description: Converge .NET schema evolution reliability to the decided cross-runtime contract.

TaskGroup.name: Characterize and define V2 contract
TaskGroup.Description: Lock Bun/C# observable cases and typed V2 contracts before implementation.

Task.name: Add paired migration rollback and legacy characterization
Task.Description: Prove strict failures, no partial state, legacy detect-only behavior and broad keyed-diff expectations.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Both runtimes have executable strict/force/rollback and legacy preservation cases.
Current C# non-atomic or permissive behavior is characterized before repair.

Task.name: Define typed V2 contracts
Task.Description: Define immutable options, diagnostics, results and keyed diff without narrowing snapshots.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: V2 defaults and compatibility wrapper boundary are explicit.

TaskGroup.name: Implement atomic schema evolution
TaskGroup.Description: Implement V2 preflight, transactionality, legacy upgrade and structured diff.

Task.name: Implement V2 preflight and atomic migration rollback
Task.Description: Apply normalized plans under one store transaction and preserve legacy wrappers.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Strict invalid operations leave all persistent schema surfaces unchanged.

Task.name: Implement legacy detection upgrade and keyed broad diff
Task.Description: Add detect-only initialization, explicit idempotent upgrade and definition-level snapshot diff.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Default initialization is non-mutating and explicit upgrade preserves data.
Diff is deterministic and includes behavior metadata.

TaskGroup.name: Cross-runtime verification and closure
TaskGroup.Description: Run full suites, target-backward review and a fresh safety gap loop.

Task.name: Verify observable parity and compatibility
Task.Description: Run Bun and C# schema matrices plus full suites.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: V2, wrappers, rollback, legacy and diff behavior have executable evidence.
